conclusions: The actual onread internal field starts as undefined; the Smi-zero language is only an unimplemented V8 TODO.
BaseObject destruction clears its pointer slot while the retained JavaScript wrapper's other internal fields survive.
The actual onread value is a traced wrapper edge, distinct from the native Global wrapper and context-frame entitlements.
Native FromObject refuses a null BaseObject slot before reading a possibly stale StreamBase pointer.
Selected FileHandle wrapper-field storage, tracing and native detach are independent of the separately pending public callback template/accessor and complete lifecycle.
